findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the interior of the cooler to be soiled with food debris. Ensure this cooler remains clean to sight and touch at all times to prevent cross-contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Employees donned gloves without washing hands first. CORRECTED- Provided education. Wash hands before donning gloves.
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands. [P]

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Single service forks at the pass-thru window observed stored mixed directions. CORRECTED- Using clean gloved hands, rearrange so utensils are handle-up/fork end down to prevent contact with the food contact ends.
4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser. [C]
